title: CYCLIC-FIXED128: doubled actual boost and prefactor-free classical/sample envelopes

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2 N), the single CYCLIC-FIXED128 algorithm of proof.md and cyclic_base.md recovers the entire s with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. Jointly on every execution branch, its total charged sequential work T is O(n^3 2^(a sqrt(n))). Here  is the exact Pell rational of cyclic_base.md Section 0, with a>sqrt(2). All constants are absolute and independent of N,s and outcomes. The algorithm fixes kappa=2 and x=s=min(mu-1,128 floor(sqrt(mu))), mu=ceil(sqrt(2B))+1, q=x+3. It recomputes every actual decoder/extractor size, mode, precision and confidence parameter, exact A_star and literal Q_star=8 A_star(G_odd+2a2)+2a2 and Qcap=1024 Q_star. Every failed, rejected, discarded and cutoff-abandoned acquisition counts. Correctness and the joint every-branch resource bounds apply to all N. The exact growth index is 1/2.

For the same single CYCLIC-FIXED128 configuration, epsilon(n)=0: every acquired copy is independent and ideal. Unconditional full-secret recovery for every N>=2 and s succeeds with probability at least 1-2^-8 jointly with all four stated every-branch resource bounds. No positive malformed fraction or maximum possible tolerance is asserted.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
